senses.gloss: (b. h., √אה, cmp. הא; v. חָוָה , a. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. אָוָה III) to point, mark. Denom. אוֹת II, תְּאָו, תַּאֲוָה.
(denom. of תַּאֲוָה, תְּאָו) to mark, to mark out.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:7">Koh. R. to XII, 7</cite> <he>התחיל מִתְאַוֶּה תאוים</he> he began to put up marks.
